text: - Invalid dates get an `invalid` class with red styling and the Book button disables (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:90-110; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:194-198); since 2026-10-10-snapshot-states the two date inputs `flight-start` and `flight-return-date` also state `aria-invalid`, so the invalid state is in the accessibility tree and the snapshot and not carried by the class alone, the class and its styling staying (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:93; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:101; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:461-496 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-snapshot-states/report.md); the headless-stand check asserts the cue without colour — a typed non-date sets `invalid` on the start field and gives `.flight-btn` a `disabled` attribute it did not carry before (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_flight_booker.rs:14-30); the stand asserts each lean task's forward focus sequence through `focus_next_node` against the shared table `tab_order` — moved into the stand checks' shared module since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness, CRUD's sequence restated there to six stops, `back-btn`, `crud-filter`, `crud-list`, `crud-name`, `crud-surname`, `crud-create`, and the flight booker's to four, `back-btn`, `flight-type`, `flight-start`, `flight-book` (`flight-return-date` joining in `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER`, five stops), the error-recovery cue unchanged (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_accessibility_ids.rs:95-110; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_accessibility_ids.rs:236-253; tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:47-63) and, in the snapshot check, that only `back-btn` reads `focused` after one such move (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot.rs:262-315)
